concerns.location: tasks.md:T006 (src/metrics/correlation.py) vs constitution Principle VI and contracts/metric_results.schema.yaml
concerns.text: No task computes Fisher's z-transformed correlation deviations. Constitution Principle VI mandates reporting 'Fisher's z-transformed correlation deviations' for every generator evaluation, and the metric-results contract includes a `fisher_z_deviation` field (plus `metric_type: FisherZ`), yet T006's correlation.py computes only 'Pearson and Spearman matrices ... absolute differences per pair, and a permutation-based correlation test'. The schema field will always be null, violating a constitution-mandated plan/contract element. Add Fisher-z computation to T006 (or a new task).

concerns.location: tasks.md:T008 vs plan.md Phase 5 and data-model.md §6
concerns.text: T008 assigns opposite error-type semantics to the correlation-perturbation control than the plan does. Plan Phase 5 and data-model.md §6 state the correlation-perturbation control 'provides false-positive rates for correlation tests', but T008 computes 'False-positive rate for marginal tests' and 'False-negative rate for correlation tests' from that same control. One of the two is wrong (statistically, the tasks.md semantics are the defensible ones), so the plan element is either uncovered or contradicted — the tasks must state which artifact governs and the discrepancy must be resolved, or the FP/FN outputs will not match the plan/data-model description.
